item.title: Copilot readiness starts with permissions, not licenses
item.description: Copilot readiness is not a license assignment problem. It is an access boundary problem. If the tenant already overshares, Copilot only makes the blast radius easier to query. That is the part that gets lost in adoption decks. A Copilot license enables the experience. It does not make SharePoint clean. It does not remove broad sharing links. It does not review stale guests. It does not make an app registration less terrifying.
